en: This is the desk of the Union Room, where Trainers from all over meet to chat, to trade and to battle.
I'm sorry to say its door is shut for now. The wireless link it runs on has gone quiet everywhere.
This is the desk of the Colosseum, where friends bring their teams to battle one another.
It is closed for the time being, I'm afraid. The wireless link is down.
At this desk Trainers mix their records and sign one another's Trainer Cards.
With the link down there is nobody to mix them with. Do ask again another day!
